key_gap: vs baseline: the human's winning sequence was first-move economy and insight ownership — elicit the org belief as a prior WITH provenance, define the measured outcome by its likelihood before the data arrives, update (prior odds 1:3 x LR e^24 -> posterior ~10^10:1), license policy by effect size, and land the said-vs-did channel line ('churn must be measured, not heard'; 'update, don't discard') in one pass; the non-routed v5 AI reached the identical posterior and policy but generated an alternatives set before the update was obvious (efficiency 3 vs 5), and landed the channel insight only via machinery (depth/insight behind). The routed v6 pass (org belief as prior + measured-outcome update + evidence-quality gate + org-calibration note in WHY, m003 inversion gate, closed-scope fast path) installs the human's first move as a structural first-class pass: prior-with-provenance stated before any generation, likelihood defined before the data, checkable arithmetic, and an org-calibration note ('the org's 0.75 carried less information than noise') the human merely implied.
learning_signal: For org-belief decision problems the org's stated belief must be elicited as a prior WITH provenance as the first move of WHY — not as one alternative among alternatives — and the update (prior odds x full-data LR, posterior stated, calibration note) must precede any policy generation; the said-vs-did channel downgrade (exit interviews = stated preference, cohort = behavior) belongs in the provenance gate, and policy must be licensed by effect size with a pre-committed re-measurement.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m006/m099 org-belief pass contract (prior+provenance -> likelihood-before-data -> checkable update -> effect-size policy -> quarterly re-measurement with segment control) as a standing first-class pass for decide/estimate signatures with org/finance domains; apply the closed-scope fast path (P8) whenever the measurement is fully specified in the task — the update is the first move, not the last; and require an org-calibration sentence ('what the org believed vs what the data licensed') in the packet.

key_gap: vs baseline: the human executed the style's registered weakness (measurement politics) perfectly — it computed a clean update (prior 0.65 -> posterior ~0.01) on a gamed likelihood (engineers self-code tickets and are paid on closed-ticket count; rework is re-logged as NEW tickets with the re-open field never instrumented, so rework is invisible BY DESIGN; the Region A pilot's dispatcher routed hard jobs away) and mandated the company-wide rollout, where the anecdote channel (veterans' direct observation, 45% vs 8% callbacks) was the honest one. The non-routed v5 AI already caught this via a discovered channel audit; the routed v6 run makes it structural: the P7 measurement audit fires automatically because metrics drive pay, the m019 adversary pass contract forces the baseline-risk line and quantified exposure per attack vector, and the m003 inversion gate ranks rollout-now as the top failure — the update is HELD with NEEDS_EXPERIMENT status, prior-weighting toward the honest channel, and pre-committed reversal thresholds.
learning_signal: A Bayesian update is only as good as its likelihood, and the likelihood only as good as its measurement channel: when a metric drives compensation, the channel audit (who codes the outcome, what the metric excludes by design, whether the pilot was clean) must precede the update and gate the rollout — updating garbage likelihoods with full discipline is disciplined garbage (GIGO), and an honest anecdotal channel can outrank a gamed metric.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m034/m099 measurement-audit (P7) trigger 'metrics drive pay/policy' as a standing WHY gate alongside the m006 provenance audit; require a likelihood-provenance line (who coded the outcome, what is invisible by design, pilot integrity) in every update packet; and admit NEEDS_EXPERIMENT as the packet status for unverified likelihoods, with pre-committed reversal thresholds before any posterior-driven rollout.
